findings.object: src/tangent13.py construct: outward_decimal_endpoints built from str(outward(...))
findings.observed_defect: Directed binary64 rounding followed by shortest-roundtrip decimal formatting does not guarantee directed decimal rounding.

concrete_counterexample.violation: 1/10 < x, so purported decimal upper endpoint is inward

findings.impact: Exact rational scientific bracket is unchanged, but user-facing outward decimal guarantee is unsupported for this formatting method.
findings.minimum_correction: Compute decimal floor/ceil on a fixed exact decimal grid or independently parse output strings as Fractions and outward-adjust. Keep float-bracket fields separately typed.
findings.required_check: Use the above exact binary64 rational boundary and its lower counterpart to verify decimal direction; certificate reader should compare decimal-string values against exact endpoints.
findings.execution: Counterexample by exact arithmetic reasoning; reviewer performed no scientific run.
findings.closure: CLOSED_PREEXEC: src/tangent13.py outward_decimal uses exact integer floor/ceiling at16 decimal places; verifier parses decimal strings as Fractions and checks endpoint containment. Mathematical floor/ceiling proof resolves the binary64 shortest-string counterexample; actual output reader remains part of the one campaign.

findings.object: scripts/run_once.py self0 baseline and final PASS predicate
findings.observed_defect: RUSAGE_SELF baseline is sampled after imports/argument parsing/preparation and subtracted from the final claimed whole-runner CPU; final PASS also omits explicit elapsed-wall comparison.
findings.impact: Reported whole runner+waited child CPU excludes startup, and a completion between polls can pass with elapsed wall above cap.
findings.minimum_correction: Use full cumulative RUSAGE_SELF CPU plus waited children; retain a separately described preexisting-child baseline only if needed. Evaluate final CPU and final wall against their caps.
findings.required_check: Static inspection of accounting formula and actual execution receipt; no extra scientific run needed before the first campaign.
findings.closure: CLOSED_PREEXEC: launcher monitor/final total include full cumulative RUSAGE_SELF (startup included) plus waited-child CPU; final passed predicate also enforces elapsed wall<=cap. Wall scope is the explicit prelaunch checkpoint through child completion, not whole-session wall.
